scope: Declared original-UPF angular intertwiners for explicitly selected saved unitary Cartesian signed-permutation operations. No complete operator or future nonlinear/antiunitary positive-time covariance claim.
source_access: Actual complete load-bearing source bytes read and SHA256-bound before this registration. Original loaded Ni/H XML and both UPF bytes read and authenticated against existing control-reference registration; no numerical construction or oracle execution performed.

original_channel_metadata.order: For each original PP_BETA radial index, QE nhtolm runs l*l through (l+1)^2-1, zero-based. Repeated radial indices remain separate, with no sorting or radial mixing.

algebra.convention: pt=R ps for column Cartesian momenta. Y_l(p @ R.T)=Y_l(p) @ Q_l(R); Bt=Bs Q. Hence Q(R2 R1)=Q(R1) Q(R2).
algebra.d: T_j are traceless quadratic polynomial tensors for ((2z^2-x^2-y^2)/2,-sqrt(3)xz,-sqrt(3)yz,sqrt(3)(x^2-y^2)/2,sqrt(3)xy). Q2_ij=(2/3) Tr(T_i.T R.T T_j R). All T_i have squared Frobenius norm 3/2.
algebra.normalization: Common sqrt((2l+1)/(4pi)) for each polynomial l block cancels; Condon-Shortley and all relative sqrt(3) factors retained.
algebra.parity: Improper signed permutations included directly. Q_l(-R)=(-1)^l Q_l(R). No det=+1 replacement.
algebra.radial: Q is block diagonal per ORIGINAL radial identity, not merely per l. Radial scalar and (-i)^l commute with each block.
algebra.D: Measure Q Dt Q-dagger minus Ds with original finite complex active matrices; no diagonalization, Hermitization or repair. Nonzero conjugacy defects remain in the existing complete bound.
algebra.floating: Analytic rational/sqrt(3) coefficient construction, floating evaluation only; not a least-squares fit or sampled projector optimization.
algebra.cartesian: Saved reciprocal S must represent the same Cartesian signed permutation within 2e-13; actual Cartesian matrix and declaration defect retained. Unsupported non-aligned cells rejected, not rounded into a different operation.

interfaces.signed_permutation(rotation): Validate and return integer (3,3) Cartesian signed permutation, det +/-1.
interfaces.harmonic_intertwiner(rotation, ell): Return float Q_l(2l+1,2l+1), ell=0,1,2 only, QE real-harmonic order.
interfaces.original_channel_intertwiner(upf, rotati: Return float Q(nh,nh) after exact original ledger validation; accepts original NCUPF and never reads or modifies D.
interfaces.intertwiner_diagnostics(intertwiner, sou: Return orthogonality, raw D Hermiticity, and conjugacy Frobenius/spectral diagnostics. target_d defaults to source_d.

oracle.production_checks: QE angular harmonics, regular solid polynomial values, exact centered derivative chain through two direction legs, interpolated centered projector API, right-action composition, orthogonality, and unchanged arbitrary complex non-Hermitian D.
oracle.fixture: Small explicitly synthetic interleaved l=(2,0,1,2,1,0) oracle-only ledger with unequal analytic radial functions; no synthetic material input.
oracle.criteria: Every relative algebra/production residual <3e-12; each named matrix mutation residual >1e-3; explicit unsupported rotation/l/ledger rejection. Material execution is separate.
